summary: Tidebreak's lessons in Practice (RingLessons, LessonCard: the owner, 2026-10-05, found switching moves hard and nothing in the game taught the controls) and a first Quick match's key hints (FirstHints). Every word here is shown to the player: no word from any show. In a line [action] is a key cap drawn from the action's binding now (InputMap: the text is right whatever the player rebound), {press} the key(s) that ready the lesson's move under the scheme, {name} its name, {form} the wheel to its form when the key is on another, {what} and {thing} the element's words below.
_doc: lessons: in order; each {id, title, dummy (stand | throw: what the practice dummy does through it), schemes (only under these; all when missing), elements (only for these; all when missing), per_element (its progress kept per element: its words differ), needs_forms (the readied move must have forms: the line says to ready one first when it has none), role (the move it teaches: attack, dodge, guard, send_back, patch; RingLessons.role_move), by: {scheme or '*': {line, do}}}. do: walk (walk_m on foot), cast (an aim cast; of the role's move when it has one), quick (a cast from the left button after the bind key), partner (the same key again: its other move readied), ready (another move readied), wheel_ready (the move wheel opened, a move readied from it), form (the wheel stepped the readied move's form), near (a cast at the near form the distance picked), guard (a guard of yours took one of its throws), knocked (the dummy pushed back a zone), out (the dummy into the water).

sounds._doc: Existing sounds (Sfx ids) as a lesson is done and as the last is: [id, gain dB, pitch].

words.finished: That is every lesson. The dummy stays: R puts you both back, B changes what it does.
words.menu_line_new: a card at a time, each done by doing it: %d lessons for %s with the %s controls
words.menu_line_done: all %d done with the %s controls: from the start again
words.panel_line: Lessons: the dummy stands while you learn to move, cast and switch, then throws at you to catch. Each card is done by doing it; Enter skips one; your place is kept.

earth.simple_what: close in first: it is a shell round you, and its stones break on it
earth.dodge_what: a dash out of the way

water.simple_what: close in, it is a bubble the fire dies in
water.dodge_what: a dash out of the way

fire.simple_what: a jet out of its way
fire.dodge_what: a hop out of the way

air.simple_what: from afar it sends the bolt back
air.dodge_what: a step out of the way

*.line: Hold [aim] on the dummy: the lock fills.  Let go to cast

keys.line: Press [weapon_2] for another move, then [weapon_2] again: the same key's other move

direction.line: Hold [move_forward] as you let go of [aim]: your attack, {name}

radial.line: Hold [bend_wheel]: every move round a wheel.  Point at one, let go: it is readied

simple.line: Press [weapon_1] to [weapon_4], or roll [weapon_next]: the next of your four moves

*.line: Roll [weapon_next]: the readied move steps through its forms

simple.line: Walk close and cast: near the dummy a move takes its near form

direction.line: Hold [move_left] or [move_right] as you let go of [aim]: {name}, {what}

radial.line: Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}, let go.  Then hold [aim], let go: {what}

simple.line: {press}: {name}.  Hold [aim], let go: it carries you

*.line: Press [bend_quick_bind]: the readied move goes on [fire].  Hold [fire], let go to cast it
{press}: Patch.  Hold [aim], let go: a little health back  ·  Mend, on the same key, makes a broken wall whole

direction.line: {press}: Patch.  Let go of [aim] with nothing held: a little health back

keys.line: It throws {thing} now.  {press}: {name}{form}.  Cast it as one comes: {what}

direction.line: It throws {thing} now.  Hold [move_back] as you let go of [aim] as one comes: {name}, {what}

radial.line: It throws {thing} now.  Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}{form}, let go.  Cast it as one comes: {what}

simple.line: It throws {thing} now.  {press}: {name}.  Cast it as one comes: {what}

keys.line: A stone held before you?  {press}: {name}.  Hold [aim], let go: it flies back

direction.line: A stone held before you?  {press}: {name}.  Let go of [aim] with nothing held: it flies back

radial.line: A stone held before you?  Hold [bend_wheel], point at {name}, let go.  Cast it: it flies back

*.line: Knock the dummy back: a hard hit pushes it back a zone at a time
Knock it off the open end into the water: that takes a round

hints._doc: FirstHints: a first Quick match's key hints, top left, by the control scheme; each row fades once one of its uses (actions) is pressed. On or off in the ring's Esc menu (GameSettings' hints section, key key_hints; the first Quick match that shows them turns them off as it ends).
hints.row_line: your control scheme's keys at the top left until you have used each

keys.line: [weapon_1] to [weapon_4]: a move, again: its other

simple.line: Hold [aim], let go: near or far picks the form
